title: Personal Credit Cards: Annual Fee Reversal Posting
content:
Personal Credit Cards annual fees that must not stay on a card are taken off with a dedicated posting tool. This page describes that tool's contract; it grants no entitlement by itself.

## Capability

The tool takes one annual fee already billed to a credit card account back off the card, in full, and records the ground for doing so. It books a single fee-reversal credit linked to the annual fee it cancels, in the statement cycle open on the day of the posting, and brings the card's balance owed down by the reversed sum at once. The cardholder sees the credit on the card's activity immediately.

## Invocation

The tool is `refund_closing_annual_fee_cfb04f99`, used by the agent. It is unlocked on the agent's side and then called by the agent; the cardholder takes no part in running it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference of the cardholder whose fee comes off, from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `card_account_id` | the credit card account billed the annual fee, from the card account lookup | identifier |
| `source_item_id` | the annual fee entry being reversed, from the card activity lookup for that account | identifier |
| `amount` | the sum reversed | USD, positive, two decimals rounded half-up |
| `adjustment_reason` | ground recorded for the reversal | one of the values below |

Accepted grounds:

- `bank_error`: the annual fee may not stand under the card charter, for instance because the card was closed inside the refund window, or because a waiver kept the fee from applying;
- `courtesy_waiver`: a goodwill reversal, never valid for an annual fee, since goodwill reversals are confined to late payment fees;
- `dispute_final`: a fee on a disputed charge settled for the cardholder, which an annual fee never is;
- `none`, `dispute_provisional` and `scra_benefit`: present in the list but never valid for a fee reversal.

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "reversed", `card_txn_id` for the new reversal entry, `card_account_id`, `reversed_fee_id` for the annual fee reversed, `amount`, `adjustment_reason`, `statement_cycle` in YYYY-MM form, `posted_date` (the posting day) and `new_current_balance`, the card's balance owed after the credit. The posting is finished once this is returned; no other outcome is defined for the tool.
